messages:
Leah Brooks: Quick note — NovaForms onboarding latency p95 creeping to ~1.9s across EU with token burn ~30% over forecast. Pattern: many short validation calls (~40 tokens) plus occasional long doc generations. I propose: 1) narrow routing for validation endpoints to a tiny quantized model (int4), 2) enable prefix KV caching for multi-step forms, 3) reserve Dedicated capacity during their 8-11am EU peak window. Thoughts?

Ravi Shah: Agreed. For validations, int4 should be fine but need to run a regression set focused on edge-case regex/formatting. Priya, can you own the eval set?

Priya Menon: On it. Will craft 30 test prompts covering edge formatting, multilingual snippets, and long tail special chars. Also will run a smoke test on the compact-1.3b-int4 candidate.

Leah Brooks: Proposed policy snippet for eng-runtime:
```json
{
  "route": "/validate",
  "selector": "token_count <= 80",
  "models": ["compact-1.3b-int4", "compact-1.3b-int8"],
  "fallback": "standard-3b",
  "dedicated_window": "08:00-11:00 Europe/London",
  "cache": {"prefix_kv": true, "ttl": 300}
}
```

Ravi Shah: @eng-runtime-bot please spin up a 4% canary for 12h starting 2026-06-10T07:00:00Z. Monitor latency p95, token usage delta, and regression_rate.

eng-runtime-bot: Canary scheduled: job_id=novaforms-canary-800123-01, start=2026-06-10T07:00:00Z, traffic=4%, duration=12h. Hooks added for latency_p95, token_delta, regression_rate.

Priya Menon: I'll run the 30-case eval immediately after canary; quality gate is <5% regression. Will post results in this thread.

Leah Brooks: I'll update the renewal tracker (status: pilot) and coordinate an enablement touchpoint for the PMs post-canary. We'll include a short ROI slide for their renewal packet.

Ravi Shah: Cool. If quality holds, estimated token cost reduction ~22%. I'll compute precise monthly delta and share.

Leah Brooks: Thanks team — tagging CS sync next Friday to review outcomes. :white_check_mark:
